headline: NextEra Energy Vs. AES Corporation: Utility Scale Energy Production Just Got a Major Blue Boost
summary: Democrats just took Congress, and clean energy stocks surged. But one utility giant is racing to build batteries for data centers while its rival has already put itself up for sale. Only one of them captured the rally.

headline: AES: Q3 Earnings Snapshot

headline: Fluence Energy names interim CEO, CFO amid supply chain hiccups

headline: Fluence Energy Stock Drops on Leadership Overhaul

headline: AES Corporation Stock Outlook: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish?
